name: Dynamos and hand-crank generators
summary: Small generators turned by hand, pedal or wheel: crank torches and radios, and bike hub and bottle dynamos.
uses: Charging a phone or small battery with no sun
Bike lights that never need batteries
identify: Crank radios and torches have a folding handle and a small geared generator inside. Bike hub dynamos are a fat front hub with two wire tabs; bottle dynamos press a ribbed wheel on the tyre. Most bike dynamos give about 6V and 3W.
test: Spin it with a meter on volts (hub dynamos give AC): you should see several volts that rise with speed. The gears should turn smoothly without slipping.

decay.note: The generators last; the small built-in batteries in crank gadgets die within a few years.
